capabilities: Visualize tracked data from notes in rendered code blocks
Track data stored in daily notes
Insert tracker code blocks via commands or manually
Browse examples and documentation in a sample vault
extras: Full documentation and examples live in a separate sample vault (the /sample-vault directory) rather than in the README itself; the README asks for donations to support development.
intentEvidence: Tracker+ is a continuation of the Tracker plugin from @pyrochlore
motivation: The original Tracker plugin had not been updated since February 2022, so the author continued it to keep new features coming.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to extract and visualize data stored across notes, such as values logged in daily notes.

relations.evidence: Tracker+ is a continuation of the Tracker plugin from @pyrochlore

summary: Code-block plugin that tracks and visualizes data from your notes, using Tracker Markdown rendered in preview mode.
